passages.title: Effect of asteroid gardening on the exogenous delivery of extraterrestrial organic matter
passages.text: Effect of asteroid gardening on the exogenous delivery of extraterrestrial organic matter. Gustavo P. Maia et al. · 2026 · Earth and Planetary Science Letters. Carbonaceous chondrites contain up to 4 wt% organic matter, likely inherited from precursors synthesised during preaccretion events. This organic inventory was later altered by hydrothermal and radiative processes, though the role of shock-induced impacts remains unclear.
passages.pt: Os condritos carbonáceos contêm até 4 % em massa de matéria orgânica, provavelmente herdada de precursores sintetizados em eventos pré-acreção. Este inventário orgânico foi posteriormente alterado por processos hidrotermais e radiativos, embora o papel dos impactos indutores de choque permaneça pouco claro.

passages.title: Effect of asteroid gardening on the exogenous delivery of extraterrestrial organic matter
passages.text: In this study, we examine the solid-state mechanochemical reactivity of hexamethylenetetramine (HMT) with sodium-rich montmorillonite (MMT) as an analogue to investigate the influence of shock- or impact-induced processes on organic matter evolution. HMT is reactive under mechanical stress, particularly when the clay mineral structure is disrupted, resulting in a wide range of molecules, including HMT-related compounds (as HMT-CH3, HMT-OH, among others), pyrazine and triazinane/triazine derivatives.
passages.pt: Neste estudo, examinamos a reatividade mecanoquímica em estado sólido da hexametilenotetramina (HMT) com montmorilonite rica em sódio (MMT), como análogo, para investigar a influência de processos induzidos por choque ou impacto na evolução da matéria orgânica. A HMT é reativa sob tensão mecânica, particularmente quando a estrutura do mineral argiloso é desagregada, originando uma vasta gama de moléculas, incluindo compostos relacionados com a HMT (como HMT-CH3, HMT-OH, entre outros), pirazina e derivados de triazinano/triazina.

passages.title: Effect of asteroid gardening on the exogenous delivery of extraterrestrial organic matter
passages.text: Notably, the incorporation of oxygen in N-rich species was also observed, despite the absence of liquid water. Conversely, when the clay mineral remains intact, mechanical input promotes the solid-state insertion of HMT-like molecules (as HMT, HMT-CH3 and triazinane derivative) within its interlayer space, thereby protecting it from further reaction.
passages.pt: Notavelmente, observou-se também a incorporação de oxigénio em espécies ricas em azoto, apesar da ausência de água líquida. Em contrapartida, quando o mineral argiloso se mantém intacto, a energia mecânica promove a inserção em estado sólido de moléculas do tipo HMT (como HMT, HMT-CH3 e derivado de triazinano) no seu espaço interlamelar, protegendo-as de reações posteriores.

passages.title: Effect of asteroid gardening on the exogenous delivery of extraterrestrial organic matter
passages.text: The “cyclic mechanical input” delivered by laboratory milling (i.e., MM 200) and grinding (i.e., McCrone) is relevant to shock processes at an asteroid surface through repeated micrometeorite and IDPs impacts (i.e., asteroid gardening). This work highlights shock/impact as a key factor driving both transformation and protection of extraterrestrial organics, offering new insights on how impact processes might have shaped extraterrestrial organic matter and consequent exogenous delivery of possibly prebiotic compounds to planetary surfaces.
passages.pt: O “input mecânico cíclico” proporcionado pela moagem laboratorial (MM 200) e trituração (McCrone) é relevante para os processos de choque na superfície de um asteroide, através de impactos repetidos de micrometeoritos e IDPs (ou seja, asteroid gardening).

passages.title: Mechanochemical Reactivity of Ribonucleosides Mediated by Inorganic Species: Implications for Extraterrestrial Organic Matter Interpretation
passages.text: Mechanochemical Reactivity of Ribonucleosides Mediated by Inorganic Species: Implications for Extraterrestrial Organic Matter Interpretation. Gustavo P. Maia, Catarina Gonçalves, Ana J. Carvalho, Vânia André, Adelino Galvão, Ana P. C. Ribeiro, Pedro F. Pinheiro and José Armando Luísa da Silva · 2025 · Applied Sciences. Metal species and carbonate are often found as minerals in extraterrestrial rocky bodies.
passages.pt: Espécies metálicas e carbonato encontram-se frequentemente como minerais em corpos rochosos extraterrestres. Com base nisto, conseguiu-se a degradação induzida mecanoquimicamente de ribonucleósidos canónicos (purinas e pirimidinas) nas suas nucleobases correspondentes, mediada por alguns dos principais constituintes desses materiais (ferro, níquel ou alumínio). Em alguns casos, o aquecimento prévio das amostras intensificou a degradação mecanoquímica.

passages.title: Mechanochemical Reactivity of Ribonucleosides Mediated by Inorganic Species: Implications for Extraterrestrial Organic Matter Interpretation
passages.text: Based on this, the mechanochemical-induced degradation of canonical purine and pyrimidine ribonucleosides into their corresponding nucleobases mediated by some of the main constituents of those materials (iron, nickel, or aluminum) was accomplished. In some cases, the previous heating of the samples intensified mechanochemical degradation. Additionally, carbonate acts as an activator for ribonucleoside degradation with a catalyst (a Lewis acid ion); however, it has almost no effect on ribonucleoside degradation in the absence of a catalyst.
passages.pt: Além disso, o carbonato atua como ativador da degradação dos ribonucleósidos na presença de um catalisador (um ião ácido de Lewis). Contudo, quase não tem efeito na ausência de catalisador. Estes resultados reforçam a hipótese de que a matéria orgânica em amostras extraterrestres poderá ter sofrido reações mecanoquímicas (ou seja, eventos de choque/impacto), desde a sua formação até à viagem para a Terra.

passages.title: Mechanochemical Reactivity of Ribonucleosides Mediated by Inorganic Species: Implications for Extraterrestrial Organic Matter Interpretation
passages.text: These results can contribute to the hypothesis that organic matter in extraterrestrial samples could have undergone mechanochemical reactions (i.e., shock/impact events), from its formation until its journey to Earth. Mechanochemical energy could occur in planetesimal accretion, asteroid formation (i.e., through planetesimal disintegration), and meteoroid atmospheric entry. Additionally, this hypothesis can clarify and relate some identified biosignatures with pathways of prebiological evolution.
passages.pt: A energia mecanoquímica pode ocorrer na acreção de planetesimais, na formação de asteroides e na entrada atmosférica de meteoroides, ajudando a relacionar biossinais identificados com vias de evolução prebiótica.

passages.title: Shock-Induced Degradation of Guanosine and Uridine Promoted by Nickel and Carbonate: Potential Applications
passages.text: Shock-Induced Degradation of Guanosine and Uridine Promoted by Nickel and Carbonate: Potential Applications. Gustavo P. Maia, José Armando Luísa da Silva, Vânia André and Adelino M. Galvão · 2023 · Molecules. Experimental studies of the degradation of two ribonucleosides (guanosine and uridine) were carried out by making use of mechanochemistry. Mechanochemical experiments reveal the decomposition of guanosine and uridine, promoted by nickel(II) and carbonate ions, into guanine and uracil, respectively.
passages.pt: Realizaram-se estudos experimentais da degradação de dois ribonucleósidos (guanosina e uridina) recorrendo à mecanoquímica. As experiências revelam a decomposição da guanosina e da uridina, promovida por iões níquel(II) e carbonato, em guanina e uracilo, respetivamente. Estas nucleobases foram identificadas por HPLC e por espetroscopia de RMN de 1H (esta apenas para o uracilo). Adicionalmente, recorreu-se à teoria do funcional da densidade (DFT) para avaliar a viabilidade energética de várias vias de degradação.

passages.title: Shock-Induced Degradation of Guanosine and Uridine Promoted by Nickel and Carbonate: Potential Applications
passages.text: These nucleobases were identified by HPLC and 1H NMR spectroscopy (this applied only to uracil). Additionally, density-functional theory (DFT) methodologies were used to probe the energetic viability of several degradation pathways, including in the presence of the abovementioned ions. Three mechanisms were analysed via ribose ring-opening: dry, single-molecule water-assisted, and metal-assisted, wherein the last two mechanisms confirmed the mechanochemical degradation of both ribonucleosides into respective nucleobase moieties.
passages.pt: Analisaram-se três mecanismos de abertura do anel da ribose (seco, assistido por uma molécula de água e assistido por metal), confirmando os dois últimos a degradação mecanoquímica de ambos os ribonucleósidos nas respetivas nucleobases. Estes resultados podem contribuir para a interpretação astrobiológica do conteúdo de amostras extraterrestres.

passages.title: Shock-Induced Degradation of Guanosine and Uridine Promoted by Nickel and Carbonate: Potential Applications
passages.text: These results can contribute to an astrobiological interpretation of the extraterrestrial sample's contents.

passages.title: Da Química Bioinorgânica para a Química Prebiótica: Levar Mais Longe o Legado do Prof. Fraústo da Silva
passages.text: Da Química Bioinorgânica para a Química Prebiótica: Levar Mais Longe o Legado do Prof. Fraústo da Silva. Ana Franco, Gustavo P. Maia and José Armando Luísa da Silva · 2023 · Boletim da Sociedade Portuguesa de Química. From Bioinorganic Chemistry to Prebiotic Chemistry: Taking the Legacy of Prof. Fraústo da Silva. Professor Fraústo da Silva played a decisive role in the introduction in Portugal, as well as in the development worldwide, of Bioinorganic Chemistry.
passages.pt: Da Química Bioinorgânica para a Química Prebiótica: Levar Mais Longe o Legado do Prof. Fraústo da Silva. O Professor Fraústo da Silva teve um papel decisivo na introdução em Portugal, bem como no desenvolvimento a nível mundial, da Química Bioinorgânica. Este texto identifica alguns dos seus contributos nesta área, assim como desenvolvimentos de outros autores em temas relacionados com a Química Bioinorgânica (com destaque para os sistemas de ferro-enxofre e de boro), que podem apoiar novas abordagens em Química Prebiótica.

passages.title: Da Química Bioinorgânica para a Química Prebiótica: Levar Mais Longe o Legado do Prof. Fraústo da Silva
passages.text: This text identifies some of his contributions in this field, as well as developments by other authors on topics related to Bioinorganic Chemistry (with emphasis on the iron-sulphur and boron systems), which can support new approaches in Prebiotic Chemistry.

passages.title: Asteroid Gardening and its Effect on Organic Matter
passages.text: Asteroid surfaces are constantly reworked by small impacts, providing a continuous mechanical input. I take molecules already known to form in ice chemistry and other space environments and ask what that bombardment actually does to them. The objective is to assess their fate. Do they degrade? Do they form new molecules? Or are they driven to interact more deeply with the surrounding mineral structures? Experiments revealed that the intensity of the mechanical input can either protect the starting organic content or drive its transformation.
passages.pt: As superfícies dos asteroides são continuamente remodeladas por pequenos impactos, que fornecem uma fonte contínua de energia mecânica. Parto de moléculas que já se sabe formarem-se em análogos de gelos interestelares e noutros ambientes espaciais, e pergunto o que esse bombardeamento lhes faz realmente. O objetivo é avaliar o seu destino. Degradam-se? Formam novas moléculas? Ou são levadas a interagir mais profundamente com as estruturas minerais circundantes?

passages.title: Asteroid Gardening and its Effect on Organic Matter
passages.text: Each outcome reveals something different about the organic matter an asteroid truly preserves and delivers. The mechanical input represents the repeated small impacts that continually rework asteroid surfaces. Starts from molecules proven to form in ice chemistry and other astrophysical environments. Experiments show that mechanical intensity can either preserve or transform the starting organic content
passages.pt: As experiências revelaram que a intensidade da energia mecânica pode tanto proteger o conteúdo orgânico inicial como promover a sua transformação. Cada resultado revela algo diferente sobre a matéria orgânica que um asteroide verdadeiramente preserva e entrega.

passages.title: Extraterrestrial Ribonucleosides: Possibility or Myth?
passages.text: Ribonucleosides, a nucleobase joined to a ribose sugar, are an essential piece of the RNA World hypothesis, the idea that RNA came before DNA and proteins at the very start of life. Ribonucleosides have not yet been detected in extraterrestrial environments, but one possibility is that they could have formed in space or on asteroid parent bodies and later been transported to Earth. My work suggests that, if such extraterrestrial ribonucleosides did form, they may have been mechanically reworked during their transport.
passages.pt: Os ribonucleósidos, uma nucleobase ligada a um açúcar (ribose), são uma peça essencial da hipótese do Mundo do RNA, a ideia de que o RNA precedeu o DNA e as proteínas no início da vida. Os ribonucleósidos ainda não foram detetados em ambientes extraterrestres, mas uma possibilidade é que se tenham formado no espaço ou nos corpos-mãe dos asteroides e sido depois transportados até à Terra.

passages.title: Extraterrestrial Ribonucleosides: Possibility or Myth?
passages.text: Using mechanochemistry, the ribonucleosides guanosine and uridine are broken back down into their nucleobases when promoted by nickel, iron or aluminium and carbonate, inorganic species found in extraterrestrial rocks. DFT calculations trace this transformation to water- and metal-assisted opening of the ribose ring. This raises the possibility that ribonucleosides formed in extraterrestrial environments could have contributed to the nucleobases we are discovering today.
passages.pt: O meu trabalho sugere que, caso esses ribonucleósidos extraterrestres se tenham de facto formado, poderão ter sido remodelados mecanicamente durante o seu transporte. Recorrendo à mecanoquímica, os ribonucleósidos guanosina e uridina decompõem-se nas suas nucleobases quando promovidos por níquel, ferro ou alumínio e carbonato, espécies inorgânicas presentes nas rochas extraterrestres. Cálculos de DFT atribuem esta transformação à abertura do anel da ribose assistida por água e por metal.

passages.title: Extraterrestrial Ribonucleosides: Possibility or Myth?
passages.text: Mechanical processing during impact and shock events could have transformed these molecules and contributed to the abundance of their nucleobases. This would not be the only possible source of nucleobases, but it suggests that mechanical energy could also have contributed to the organic inventory delivered to early Earth. More broadly, mechanochemistry can do more than simply preserve organic molecules.
passages.pt: Isto levanta a possibilidade de que ribonucleósidos formados em ambientes extraterrestres possam ter contribuído para as nucleobases que hoje estamos a descobrir. O processamento mecânico durante eventos de impacto e choque poderá ter transformado estas moléculas e contribuído para a abundância das suas nucleobases. Esta não seria a única fonte possível de nucleobases, mas sugere que a energia mecânica poderá também ter contribuído para o inventário orgânico entregue à Terra primitiva.

passages.title: Extraterrestrial Ribonucleosides: Possibility or Myth?
passages.text: It can drive the formation of new molecules or degrade more complex organics into simpler products, showing how mechanical energy can actively reshape the molecular inventory of extraterrestrial materials.
passages.pt: De forma mais geral, a mecanoquímica pode fazer mais do que simplesmente preservar moléculas orgânicas. Pode promover a formação de novas moléculas ou degradar compostos orgânicos mais complexos em produtos mais simples, mostrando como a energia mecânica pode remodelar ativamente o inventário molecular dos materiais extraterrestres.

passages.title: Asteroid gardening and the fate of extraterrestrial organic matter
passages.text: Asteroid gardening and the fate of extraterrestrial organic matter. How repeated micrometeorite and dust impacts on asteroid surfaces transform, or protect, the organic matter that asteroids deliver to planets. Ball milling and grinding of hexamethylenetetramine (HMT) with sodium-rich montmorillonite, an analogue of the clays in carbonaceous chondrites, stand in for the impacts.
passages.pt: Como os impactos repetidos de micrometeoritos e poeiras nas superfícies dos asteroides transformam, ou protegem, a matéria orgânica que os asteroides entregam aos planetas. A moagem e a trituração de hexametilenotetramina (HMT) com montmorilonite sódica, um análogo das argilas dos condritos carbonáceos, reproduzem os impactos.

passages.title: Asteroid gardening and the fate of extraterrestrial organic matter
passages.text: High-energy milling disrupts the clay and turns HMT into new species (pyrazine, triazine/triazinane derivatives, oxygen-bearing N-rich molecules) even without liquid water; gentler grinding pushes HMT-like molecules between the clay layers, where they are protected.
passages.pt: A moagem de alta energia desorganiza a argila e transforma a HMT em novas espécies (pirazina, derivados de triazina/triazinano, moléculas azotadas com oxigénio) mesmo sem água líquida; a trituração mais suave introduz moléculas do tipo HMT entre as camadas da argila, onde ficam protegidas.

passages.title: Mechanochemistry of ribonucleosides
passages.text: Mechanochemistry of ribonucleosides. Can ribonucleosides, building blocks of RNA, survive the mechanical energy of impacts, or are they broken back down into nucleobases and ribose? Guanosine, uridine and other ribonucleosides are milled with metal species and carbonate, minerals common on rocky extraterrestrial bodies. The experiments show that they degrade into their nucleobases, with consequences for how organic matter in meteorites is interpreted.
passages.pt: Poderão os ribonucleósidos, blocos de construção do RNA, sobreviver à energia mecânica dos impactos, ou são decompostos de novo em nucleobases e ribose? A guanosina, a uridina e outros ribonucleósidos são moídos com espécies metálicas e carbonato, minerais comuns em corpos rochosos extraterrestres. As experiências mostram que se degradam nas suas nucleobases, com consequências para a interpretação da matéria orgânica dos meteoritos.

passages.text: PhD in Chemistry (Astrobiology). 2023–2027 · Ongoing · Universidade de Lisboa · Instituto Superior Técnico. Mechanochemical energy and prebiotic synthesis. My PhD research focuses on understanding how mechanochemical energy (the energy generated from mechanical forces such as grinding, milling, and impact) can drive the synthesis of prebiotic organic molecules. This work explores alternative pathways for the origin of life that don't rely solely on aqueous chemistry.
passages.pt: Doutoramento em Química (Astrobiologia). 2023–2027 · Em curso · Universidade de Lisboa · Instituto Superior Técnico. Energia mecanoquímica e síntese prebiótica

passages.title: PhD in Chemistry (Astrobiology)
passages.text: The research investigates shock-driven chemistry under planetary conditions, simulating impact events that would have occurred on early Earth and other celestial bodies. By studying these high-energy processes, we aim to understand how the building blocks of life could have formed in extreme environments.

passages.title: PhD in Chemistry (Astrobiology)
passages.text: This interdisciplinary work combines synthetic chemistry, analytical techniques, computational modeling, and astrobiological perspectives to address fundamental questions about chemical evolution and the conditions that led to the emergence of life.

passages.title: MSc in Chemistry
passages.text: MSc in Chemistry. 2020–2022 · Concluded · Instituto Superior Técnico. Ribonucleoside stability and prebiotic synthesis. Exogenous delivery of organic molecules could have played a significant role in prebiotic synthesis, based on the detection of RNA nucleobases and ribose in meteorites. However, ribonucleosides were never detected. Meteoroid atmospheric entry conditions are severe and could lead to chemical modifications via mechanochemical reactions.
passages.pt: Mestrado em Química. 2020–2022 · Concluído · Instituto Superior Técnico. Estabilidade de ribonucleósidos e síntese prebiótica

passages.title: MSc in Chemistry
passages.text: Moreover, oxidation reactions are also plausible, producing reactive species such as carbonate (CO 3 2− ). In this way, the mechanochemical treatment of ribonucleosides with carbonate and metal salts (Ni, Al, Na, and K, which are present within meteoroids) was explored, leading to the formation of guanine, adenine, and uracil as degradation products. Ethanol formation was observed for metal samples (Ni 2+ and Al 3+ ), indicating ribose decomposition.

passages.title: MSc in Chemistry
passages.text: Additionally, degradation mechanisms using theoretical studies were performed with carbonate and ribonucleosides as reagents, suggesting that water-assisted ring opening was the preferred mechanism. Considering the aforementioned results, this work proposes that ribonucleoside degradation through mechanochemical reactions, intensified by carbonate and metal ions, is a novel model that justifies the presence of nucleobases in meteorite extracts.

passages.text: BSc in Industrial Chemistry. 2017–2020 · Universidade da Beira Interior. Optimization of quinoline N-oxide synthesis. Heterocyclic compounds have been studied since the last century. Due to the presence of heteroatoms, these compounds exhibit unique chemical and physical properties, which allow them to interact efficiently with other molecules or even with biological systems.

passages.title: BSc in Industrial Chemistry
passages.text: Within this group of compounds are heterocyclic N-oxides, which have attracted significant attention because of the roles they play as synthetic intermediates, protecting groups, oxidizing agents, catalysts, and ligands in metal complexes. In addition, heterocyclic N-oxides have emerged as a class of compounds with anticancer, antibacterial, antihypertensive, antiparasitic, anti-HIV, anti-inflammatory, herbicidal, and neuroprotective activities.

passages.title: BSc in Industrial Chemistry
passages.text: With the aim of optimizing the formation of quinoline N-oxides from the reduction of (2-(2-nitrobenzylidene)cyclohexane-1,3-dione), eight different reaction conditions were tested, involving five distinct reducing agents. In this way, it was possible to obtain the quinoline N-oxide exclusively by using either stannous chloride or its dihydrate analogue as reducing agents, at room temperature, with yields of 67% and 53%, respectively.

passages.title: BSc in Industrial Chemistry
passages.text: In all other attempts, using different reducing agents under different reaction conditions, a mixture of quinoline N-oxide and the corresponding quinoline was obtained. All compounds or mixtures of compounds obtained were characterized by proton nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy.
